newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank ends meeting, no rate changes.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank ends meeting, no rate changes.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, ended its board meeting on Thursday without making any changes to interest rates.
The market had not expected the bank to announce any moves to lower its interest rate corridor despite a further cut in the central rate of its three tier system, the repo, earlier this week.
On Tuesday, the Riksbank cut the repo rate, its key tool for controlling money market liquidity, by another 10 basis points to 4.95 percent.
This was the 21st cut this year to the repo that stood at 8.91 percent in early January.
The floor of the bank's interest rate corridor, the deposit rate, currently stands at 4.75 percent and the ceiling, its lending rate, at 6.25 percent.
The Riksbank last lowered its interest rate corridor on August 15.
